title: Tess OS Advisory Adapter Manifest v1
description: A local, descriptive record of one Tess OS provider or harness surface. It records currently observed integration capability and limits; it does not grant authority, access, approval, signing, key custody, verifier registration, policy enforcement, or protected-workflow certification. This schema is intentionally outside core/contracts and is validated only by the offline repository test harness until a separately reviewed core-contract proposal is accepted.

schema_version.description: Pins this descriptive record to the v1 advisory contract.

adapter_id.description: Allowlisted stable lowercase identifier for a provider or harness surface. A new identifier needs an explicit schema, manifest-directory, source-parity, and review update; an unknown manifest may not bypass the advisory checks.

provider.description: Human-readable provider or host name. It is an attribution label, not a trust identity.

support_level.description: Observed integration level only. C4 is deliberately excluded: certified protected delivery requires independent evidence and an external trust root, never a self-authored manifest.

status.description: Public-status label aligned with docs/STATUS.md. This record does not make a release, production, or security claim.

capabilities.description: Narrow, observable integration surfaces. Capability entries are descriptive; none grants an action, permission, secret, approval, or trust role.

evidence.description: Repository-local pointers supporting the stated surface. Evidence is not an approval or a conformance certificate.

limits.description: Known boundaries that prevent the manifest from being read as a universal-support claim.

then.$comment: A C0 record documents absence of an adapter; it cannot advertise a capability.

else.$comment: C1-C3 records remain preview-only until independently certified; an empty capability list would be misleading.

kind.description: Evidence category; both refer to repository-local material only.

path.description: Repository-relative path. The offline test harness rejects absolute paths, parent traversal, symlink escape, and missing or non-regular targets; it never contacts a provider.

note.description: Short explanation of what the local artifact establishes and what it does not.

$comment: Uses only the dependency-free JSON Schema subset already exercised by the repository test harness: type, enum, const, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, minItems, maxItems, minLength, pattern, if/then/else, allOf, $ref, $defs.
